notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}.
description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trench Behemoth twice by returning two lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting both lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the lands.
Repeat.
